---
name: 🎆 Feature request
about: Request a feature in this project
title: '[FEATURE]'
labels: 'enhancement, untriaged'
assignees: ''
---
**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is, e.g. _I'm always frustrated when [...]_

**What solution would you like?**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**What alternatives have you considered?**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Do you have any additional context?**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. If the request concerns a Lance table shape the plugin does not map or a query shape it routes to the shard path, include the Arrow schema and the search body.
